subject.title: fix(config): use Object.hasOwn in restoreEnvVarRefs to avoid prototype pollution

question: Should a repository security/admin owner authorize the current head's dependency and workflow changes, or should this PR be reduced to the stated config fix before normal review continues?
rationale: The current head changes the dependency graph and adds broad unrelated automation while carrying a protected `security` label; the intended trust boundary cannot be inferred from the PR title or contributor proof.

options.title: Require a narrow config-only branch
options.body: Remove all unrelated changes and retain only the `Object.hasOwn` repair plus focused regression coverage before ordinary review resumes.

options.title: Authorize the current broad head
options.body: A repository security or administrator owner explicitly accepts the dependency graph and unrelated workflow changes and assigns complete review coverage for them.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the PR open for human security triage if neither a narrow rescope nor explicit authorization is appropriate.

recommendation.title: Require a narrow config-only branch
recommendation.body: Remove all unrelated changes and retain only the `Object.hasOwn` repair plus focused regression coverage before ordinary review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct involvement in the affected CI and security-adjacent integration surfaces.
